title: Tiga Ratus Petir
mood: giddy and breathless, a festival-night rush
subject: the girl at a festival's glitter face-paint booth who paints the same lightning bolt on three hundred faces before the headliner, then paints one on herself and runs for the main stage
caption: Indonesian festival EDM in the future-bass style, with a traditional string hook. A plucked Sumba jungga, a bright two-string lute, playing a short pentatonic riff over sustained pads in the intro and returning between vocal lines; stacked supersaw chords sidechained hard to the kick; LFO-wobbled future-bass chords in the drops, felt in half-time; a deep 808 sub under the drops; snare rolls and white-noise risers into each drop, with fast hi-hat rolls only in the breakdown. Glossy and wide, the jungga and the lead vocal forward in the verses, the chords huge and pumping in the drops. Bright, clear female pop voice, light and conversational in the verses and belting the hook, mixing Indonesian lines with short English phrases, one live singer throughout. 144 BPM, F major. Giddy and breathless, a festival-night rush. No sampled voice hooks, no formant-shifted ad-libs, no dubstep growl bass, no trap beat under the verses, no big-room house drop, no autotune, no rap verse.
lyrics:
[Intro - plucked jungga riff over a soft pad]

[Verse 1]
Jam tiga sore aku buka meja lipat
Glitter emas, kuas kecil, cermin retak
Yang antre pertama minta petir di pipi
Yang kedua juga, yang ketiga juga

[Pre-Chorus - snare roll rising]
Jam delapan tanganku udah hafal
Garis, belok, garis, tutup pakai glitter

[Chorus]
One more bolt, satu lagi
Pipi kiri, tahan, jangan senyum dulu
Tiga ratus petir lewat mejaku
Semua lari ke depan, aku masih di sini

[Drop - supersaw chords and wobbling bass, jungga riff on top]

[Verse 2]
Cowok berkumis minta petir di jidat
Satpam diam-diam minta satu juga
Dari jauh soundcheck headliner mulai
Kuasku gemetar, glitternya tinggal dikit

[Chorus]
One more bolt, satu lagi
Pipi kiri, tahan, jangan senyum dulu
Tiga ratus satu, tiga ratus dua
Lampu panggung utama udah nyala

[Bridge - breakdown, half-time hi-hats, then a long riser]
Terus antreannya habis
Aku lihat cermin retak itu
Satu petir terakhir, buat aku sendiri

[Chorus]
One more bolt, buat aku
Pipi kiri, glitter sisa terakhir
Meja kulipat, aku lari ke depan
Lagu pertama, aku sampai juga

[Outro - jungga riff alone over the last pad]
